speaker: Ulfra of Skarn
description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7, §5.9, §5.10): Ulfra, chief of Skarn Steading. Her plea (stage 5) starts the siege of Skarn (world.skarn.plea_accepted: event.siege_of_skarn's condition; a stage-6 giant arriving at Skarn starts it too). Saved, Skarn gives its support (world.skarn.support, the event's saved flags) and its hearth-forge; burned, she asks for the roof beams to be raised (quest.skarn_rebuild, stage 6). Offended (faction.skarn hostile), she only takes 2 iron for the harm (outcome reconcile_skarn: FactionState reconciles the steading). A Stoneblood giant hears a line of her own.

nodes.text: A giant out of the lowlands... Sit, if the bench will hold you. I am Ulfra, chief of Skarn. We have trouble coming: the toll-riders - Aldmere's hired siege company - mean to burn Skarn out with their engines, because we would not bar the Moot to rival giants as Harrok's clan does.

choices.text: I will stand with Skarn. Let them come.
choices.locked_text: Return when you stand at stage 5 - a smaller giant cannot break a siege line

choices.text: [Stoneblood] The old kings' stone is in my blood, chief.
choices.locked_text: Only a Stoneblood giant can say this

nodes.text: Stoneblood! Then you are kin to the kings who raised the Moot's stones. Skarn would be proud to stand behind you when the clans gather - if Skarn still stands.

choices.text: I will stand with Skarn. Let them come.
choices.locked_text: Return when you stand at stage 5 - a smaller giant cannot break a siege line

nodes.text: Then stand on our green when they come. Their siege line sets up east of the steading: break its engines - smash them, or tear them up and throw them if you are tall enough - before two of our halls burn. While you are far from Skarn their engines hold their fire; they start again when you come back.
The toll-riders' siege line is coming up from the east. Stand on our green, and break their engines before our halls burn.
The engines! Break them, giant, before our halls burn!

They burned Skarn... Two of our halls are ash. If you would still help us, lift the roof beams back onto our longhouses - only a giant of the old height, stage 6, can raise them. Then Skarn will stand with you again.
Skarn stands because of you. Our hearth-forge is yours, and when the clans gather at the Moot, Skarn will stand at your back.
Our halls stand again, raised by your hands. Skarn will stand at your back at the Moot.
You struck Skarn's hall! Pay for the harm you did, giant - or get out of my steading.
...It is paid. Skarn's hall is open to you again.
